hook.en: A camera flash needs a sudden burst of energy that a small cell cannot give at once. A capacitor stores charge slowly and lets it all go in a flash.
hook.kn: ಕ್ಯಾಮೆರಾ ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಶ್‌ಗೆ ಒಮ್ಮೆಲೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಶಕ್ತಿ ಬೇಕು, ಅದನ್ನು ಸಣ್ಣ ಕೋಶ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಕೊಡಲಾರದು. ಧಾರಕವು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಆವೇಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ ಒಂದೇ ಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Define capacitance and find it for a parallel plate capacitor.
Find the effect of a dielectric or metal slab on capacitance.

narration.en: A camera flash needs a sudden burst of energy that a small cell cannot give at once. A capacitor stores charge slowly and lets it all go in a flash.
narration.kn: ಕ್ಯಾಮೆರಾ ಫ್ಲ್ಯಾಶ್‌ಗೆ ಒಮ್ಮೆಲೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಶಕ್ತಿ ಬೇಕು, ಅದನ್ನು ಸಣ್ಣ ಕೋಶ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಕೊಡಲಾರದು. ಧಾರಕವು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಆವೇಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ ಒಂದೇ ಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Capacitance and the parallel plate capacitor

body.en: A capacitor is two conductors separated by an insulator, carrying charges +Q and −Q. Its capacitance C = Q/V depends only on size, shape, separation and the medium, not on Q or V. Unit: farad (1 F = 1 C V⁻¹); practical units are μF, nF and pF. For two parallel plates of area A, separation d, in vacuum: $C = \varepsilon_0A/d$.
body.kn: ಧಾರಕ ಎಂದರೆ ನಿರೋಧಕದಿಂದ ಬೇರ್ಪಟ್ಟ +Q ಮತ್ತು −Q ಆವೇಶದ ಎರಡು ವಾಹಕಗಳು. ಧಾರಕತೆ C = Q/V, ಏಕಮಾನ ಫ್ಯಾರಡ್. ಸಮಾಂತರ ಫಲಕ ಧಾರಕ: C = ε₀A/d.

points.en: Depends on geometry and medium only

narration.en: A capacitor is two conductors with equal and opposite charges. Capacitance is Q by V, measured in farad. For parallel plates in vacuum it is epsilon nought A by d.
narration.kn: ಧಾರಕ ಎಂದರೆ ನಿರೋಧಕದಿಂದ ಬೇರ್ಪಟ್ಟ +Q ಮತ್ತು −Q ಆವೇಶದ ಎರಡು ವಾಹಕಗಳು. ಧಾರಕತೆ C = Q/V, ಏಕಮಾನ ಫ್ಯಾರಡ್. ಸಮಾಂತರ ಫಲಕ ಧಾರಕ: C = ε₀A/d.

body.en: Filling the whole gap with a dielectric of constant K multiplies the capacitance by K: $C = K\varepsilon_0A/d$. A slab of thickness t (< d) gives $C = \varepsilon_0A/(d - t + t/K)$. A metal slab of thickness t behaves like K → ∞: $C = \varepsilon_0A/(d - t)$.
body.kn: ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು K ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತುವಿನಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದರೆ ಧಾರಕತೆ K ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. t ದಪ್ಪದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t + t/K); ಲೋಹದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t).

narration.en: Filling the gap with a dielectric multiplies C by K. A slab of thickness t gives epsilon nought A over d minus t plus t by K. A metal slab simply reduces the gap to d minus t.
narration.kn: ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು K ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತುವಿನಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದರೆ ಧಾರಕತೆ K ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. t ದಪ್ಪದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t + t/K); ಲೋಹದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t).

aim.en: To study the charging and discharging of a capacitor through a resistor and determine the time constant.

narration.en: Watch a capacitor fill with charge through a resistor. The voltage rises quickly at first and then levels off at the battery voltage: the capacitor is now storing Q equal to C V.

problem.en: A parallel plate capacitor has plates of area 6 × 10⁻³ m² separated by 3 mm of air. Find its capacitance and the charge on each plate when connected to 100 V.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A parallel plate capacitor has plates of area 6 × 10⁻³ m² separated by 3 mm of air. Find its capacitance and the charge on each plate when connected to 100 V.

problem.en: The gap of the same capacitor is filled with mica (K = 6) while the battery stays connected. Find the new capacitance and charge.

steps.en: The battery holds V at 100 V.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. The gap of the same capacitor is filled with mica (K = 6) while the battery stays connected. Find the new capacitance and charge.

heading.en: Battery on: V stays. Battery off: Q stays.

body.en: Insert a dielectric K. Battery connected: V fixed, so C, Q and stored energy all become K times. Battery disconnected: Q fixed, so C becomes K times while V, E and the stored energy fall K times.

narration.en: Battery on: V stays. Battery off: Q stays.. Insert a dielectric K. Battery connected: V fixed, so C, Q and stored energy all become K times. Battery disconnected: Q fixed, so C becomes K times while V, E and the stored energy fall K times.

mnemonic.en: ON → V constant; OFF → Q constant

narration.kn: ಹಾಜರಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕ್ರಮಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಿ.

points.en: A dielectric multiplies C by K.
points.kn: ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತು C ಯನ್ನು K ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Battery connected: V fixed; disconnected: Q fixed.
points.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ: V ಸ್ಥಿರ; ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿದಾಗ: Q ಸ್ಥಿರ.

homework.en: A 10 pF air capacitor is filled with a dielectric of K = 2.5 after disconnecting it from a 50 V supply. Find the new C, Q and V.

narration.en: Recap. C = Q/V; unit farad. Parallel plates: C = ε₀A/d. A dielectric multiplies C by K. Battery connected: V fixed; disconnected: Q fixed.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. C = Q/V; ಏಕಮಾನ ಫ್ಯಾರಡ್. ಸಮಾಂತರ ಫಲಕಗಳು: C = ε₀A/d. ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತು C ಯನ್ನು K ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ: V ಸ್ಥಿರ; ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿದಾಗ: Q ಸ್ಥಿರ.
